exposure: Traditional method of childbirth preparation (PG E2 - dinoprostone intravaginally)
Complex method of childbirth preparation (Foley catheter + oral prostaglandin E1)
outcome: Perinatal morbidity (neonatal asphyxia, diabetic fetopathy, hypoglycemia, CNS disorders)
cohort: The study included 136 pregnant women, divided into four groups: obese, obese with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), GDM only, and a control group with physiological pregnancy.
finding: Childbirth in women with obesity and GDM is associated with increased obstetric complications, including premature rupture of membranes, weakness of labor, fetal distress, clinically narrow pelvis, and ineffective induction of labor, leading to higher rates of cesarean sections and perinatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The study found an increased rate of cesarean section in women with obesity and GDM, and suggests that a comprehensive preparation for childbirth (Foley catheter and PGE1 combined with epidural anesthesia and half-dose oxytocin) reduces the cesarean section rate and perinatal complications.
